chapters.label: Just before half-time
chapters.text: Cardiff, May 2004, the FA Cup final: Manchester United against Millwall, a minute before half-time. Roy Keane passes, and right-back Gary Neville races into the box. He chips a cross... Ronaldo heads it in. Goal!

chapters.label: The overlap
chapters.text: Watch his run. Ronaldo goes inside, and his defender follows. So Neville sprints round the outside, into space.

chapters.label: Far post
chapters.text: From behind the goal: the cross drops toward a defender, but Ronaldo steals in front to head it down. United lead!

chapters.label: Give a choice
chapters.text: Like Neville: give your winger a pass option on the outside, so they have a choice.
